t.en: “Resolve” refuses when two pairs could cancel. “It rains ∨ it is windy” and “¬it rains ∨ ¬it is windy” hold two: cancel both at once and nothing is left, as if a contradiction followed. Why not cancel both?

brief.en: Find a row of the truth table where “it rains ∨ it is windy” and “¬it rains ∨ ¬it is windy” are both true.

hint.en: Try the row with rain and no wind.
